# server-contributors-in-sync

Fails if `plugins/framework/plugins/server-core/core/contributors.generated.ts`
drifts from the server contributions the barrels make: which graph nodes
contribute to which server list kind. A job process that starts only some
plugins (server-core's `resolveStartSet`) starts the contributors of the lists
its job reads from this table, and guards every other complete list against
it — so a stale copy starts too few plugins or names the wrong ones missing.
Fix by running `./equin build` and committing the regenerated file.
